blind_coding.reasoning: Forty independently identified original papers were actually replicated. Appendix 1 supplies target-specific overall subjective verdicts and original study numbers; planned but replaced studies (Cushman et al. 2006, Malle 2006, Lam 2010, Zalla and Leboyer 2011) are excluded. Each appendix entry is copied verbatim because the explicit verdicts occur in list annotations rather than narrative sentences. One target has contradictory verdicts and is left undetermined. No DOI is supplied for any original because none was printed in its inspected reference entry. The supplied url_r points to one component target rather than the overall project; article identity was therefore verified by DOI, title and publisher authors. Primary cached full text has no original source URL or parser metadata; publisher identity and references are supplemental and this provenance limitation is retained.
blind_coding.parser: parent-supplied cache helper (unspecified); BeautifulSoup html.parser for publisher metadata and references
blind_coding.provenance_note: Main article full text came from the parent-supplied cache, whose originating URL, retrieval time and extraction helper were unavailable. source_url and retrieved_at describe the independently retrieved publisher identity/reference supplement. No claim is made that the publisher supplied the cached body.
